lines.text: After Solomon finished building the temple and the palace, the LORD appeared to him a second time, as at Gibeon.
The LORD said He had heard Solomon's prayer and consecrated the temple by putting His Name there forever.
If Solomon walked as his father Moses did, God would establish his royal throne over Israel forever.
If Solomon or his sons served other gods, the LORD would cut Israel off from the land and make Israel an object of envy.
Passersby would ask why the LORD did this, and the answer would be that Israel forsook the LORD who brought their fathers out of Egypt.
